title: Capstone: Blackjack
description:
```
Dealer shows: K♠  [hidden]
Your hand: 7♥ 9♦ (16)
(h)it or (s)tand? h
You drew 4♣ → 20
Dealer reveals 6♦ → 16, hits... 8♠ → 24 BUST!
You win! Chips: 120
```
hints: Build it in this order, running after each step: make and print a deck; shuffle it and deal two cards; work out a hand's value; the player's hit-or-stand loop; the dealer's turn; chips and the play-again loop.
Aces: count every ace as 11 first, then while the total is over 21 and you still have an ace counted as 11, take 10 off.
Dealing is taking the next card: keep an index `std::size_t next{ 0 };` into the shuffled deck and use `deck[next++]`. Reshuffle when fewer than 15 cards are left.
requirements: `enum class Suit`, `enum class Rank` and `struct Card` (lessons 4.05 and 4.06)
Betting with chips; play until broke or quit
Stretch: splitting, doubling down, multiple decks (shoe)
